name_reason: Name accurately reflects the function: it is the main LOAD GAME entry point that reads FD2.SAV, decrypts + checksum-validates it, restores all engine/battle/UI scalar+buffer state and reloads the chapter's resource files, then plays the load-game cinematic intro. Follows the fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (life/main lifecycle domain). The numeric tokens in the comments (0x10010, etc.) are address annotations in comments, not part of the symbol name, so there is no address residue in the name itself.
purpose: Main LOAD GAME path: read FD2.SAV, decrypt + validate checksum, restore all engine state and reload the saved chapter's resources, then play the load-game cinematic intro.
logic_summary: malloc(0x59CB) save buffer (OOM -> reset video via int 0x10 + printf OOM + exit). fopen/fread FD2.SAV; fd2_save_crypt_buffer XOR-decrypts in place; if fd2_save_compute_checksum != stored checksum at +0x59C7 show a checksum-mismatch dialog (portrait 0x4B + dialog scene). Fade to black, then restore: party roster buffer (memmove 0xA00 from +0x8A3), reload FDOTHER.DAT palette, read current_chapter_id from pBuf[0x30C5], load FDFIELD chapter map metadata (chapter*3+2, scratch), free+realloc tile_event_data_table (0x8A3) and copy from pBuf[0], load chapter background layers, FDTXT chapter text (chapter+1), FDFIELD battle tile map (chapter*3) and read map width/height, FDSHAP scene snapshot + tile-attribute flags via scene_id from tile_event[0], obfuscate battle tile map, set portrait-cache total size/alloc offset from tile_event[1..2], read party_member_count from pBuf[0x30C4]. Free+realloc runtime_char_array (0x1E00), memmove party records (count*0x50) from +0x12A3, memmove tile-event consumed flags (0x20) from +0x30A3. Free old portrait sprite cache; reopen FDICON.B24 and rebuild the portrait cache (per party member fd2_load_portrait_to_cache, store slot into runtime_char[i].sprite_state[0]); dump the cache (0x32A00 B) to the FD2.TMP swap file. Restore scalar engine state from the save header tail (+0x30C3..+0x30D4): turn counter, view-window origin x/y, cursor world x/y, cursor screen x/y, menu party member count, party gold (dword @ +0x30CD), game-speed flag, terrain-HUD-enabled flag, BGM/SFX enabled flags. Free pBuf and the FDFIELD scratch buffer. Set per-chapter player-turn BGM with fade, clear battle_anim_phase, tick tile-event animations, composite battle frame, palette fade-in. Then two cinematic loops: (1) 9 frames blitting sprite-sheet indices 0x53..0x5B to 0xA0000 (the last 3 overlaying the restored turn counter as a decimal), with per-frame delays; (2) a 4-frame zoom-in (i=2..4 then i=9) into the large_game_state_buffer overlay scaling by i*i, rendering the turn counter and blitting the result, with bios-tick waits. Final composite_battle_frame(0), 200ms delay, reset current_active_char_idx=0, battle_anim_phase=1, clear keyboard buffer.

returns.semantics: No return value. Restores global engine state and renders the load cinematic via side effects; on any malloc failure it calls exit(1) and never returns.
